section.title: Seats
section.desc: Seats follow roles. Each user with any permission of an application takes one seat of it.
section.manual: This workspace still assigns seats by hand.
section.grace: Reduce {{module}} to {{capacity}} users by {{date}}. After that, the most recently added users become read-only.

page.note: The full subscription page is coming. Seats are shown here.

down.title: Reduce seats
down.appHint: The application whose seats you want to lower.
down.targetHint: You can lower seats only to a number that fits the users who keep a seat.
down.targetInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
down.cannotReduce: This application already has 1 seat and cannot be reduced further.
down.keepHint: Choose the users who keep their seat. The others lose the roles that give this application.
down.noRemovals: No users will lose their seat.
down.summary: {{n}} users will lose their {{module}} seat. Their roles that give {{module}} are removed.
down.confirm: This removes roles from {{n}} users. Continue?
down.done: Seats freed. Now lower the seat count in your subscription.

unsaved.title: Leave without freeing seats?
unsaved.text: Your seat reduction choices have not been applied.

mig.title: Switch to automatic seats
mig.explain: Automatic seats follow roles. Users with roles but no seat will get one; seats of users without a matching role are released.
mig.short: Some applications need more seats first:

conflict.title: Seat usage changed
conflict.text: Seat usage was updated since you started. Reload to review the latest holders.
